description: createApiKey accepts a non-null harnessId (data.harnessId) and inserts without any try/catch, so calling it with a harnessId whose (userId,orgId,harnessId) triple already has an active row raises a raw Postgres 23505 from uq_api_keys_active_harness that is never mapped to the ApiKeyManagerError('CONFLICT') sentinel the harness methods produce, leaking a DB-level error to callers.
title: createApiKey leaks raw 23505 from the active-harness partial index instead of CONFLICT
